SPA+CLINIC Has Launched SCRIPTED

  • 22 hours ago
  • Read Time: 1 minute
  • by Professional Beauty Team

An exclusive online publication for medi-aesthetic professionals.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:33
Instaread

For over 26 years, our sister publication SPA+CLINIC has been the voice of the aesthetic and wellness industries, but with the medi-aesthetics sector expanding rapidly in recent years, they recognised the need for a dedicated online publication for AHPRA-registered aesthetic medical practitioners.

Introducing: SCRIPTED by SPA+CLINIC

SCRIPTED takes the conversation beyond what is possible in consumer-facing media. They’ll bring medical practitioners the information and education they need to stay ahead in this ever evolving industry: Schedule-4 news and launches, prescription protocols, injecting techniques, surgical procedures, training events, and much more!

Editorial in voice. Gated by design. Verified at the door.

Sign up for the eNewsletter

Register here for the beauty industry's premiere online news service.

If you’re a HCP, request access to SCRIPTED now and you will receive full access once verified, plus Australia’s first cosmetic injectables e-book, SCRIPTED CONFIDENTIAL.

Want a sneak-peek at the kind of content they’ve got waiting for you? Here you go…

How this injector turned the constraint on B&As into an opportunity; an exclusive look at the Lift&Lock technique with Dr Jimmy Wang; how do biostimulators fit into modern acne scar management protocols? And so much more!

Request access to SCRIPTED here.
